qwen3_vl.image_sampling: single target crop only; no crop search or test feedback
qwen3_vl.training_scope: development only; fixed one epoch; compare both predeclared variants
qwen3_vl.validation_policy: one predeclared epoch; no validation-driven checkpoint selection; both variants are evaluated once after global freeze
qwen3_vl.license_note: Check upstream model and dataset licenses before redistribution.

limitations: The holdout is a group-isolated diagnostic subset and covers 8 of 12 labels, not a complete 12-class test.
Conservative image-scene groups have not been authenticated as independent flights or source videos.
The grouped development CV scores only classes with at least two development constraint groups; singleton-group classes remain in every training fold.
The task is classification of author-box target crops, not end-to-end object detection.
The 135 web-collected weak-label crops are not used for supervised training or final testing.
The auxiliary synthetic dataset is not merged into this 12-class task.
No paired per-flight text or telemetry is available; this is a visual-language model image-only experiment, not multimodal sensor fusion.
